name: Longsword of Wounding
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra {@damage 2d6} Necrotic damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be unable to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} for 1 hour. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
